skill.name: php-static-analysis
skill.description: Implementation guidance for making PHP code provably typed under a strict static analyzer.
skill.author: Agent Skills Team

name: php-static-analysis
description: Native types first, precise shapes and generics, honest contracts, scoped ignores, and analyzer extensions instead of inline casts.

categories.name: Native Types First
categories.description: PHPDoc used where a real PHP type would make the contract enforceable

categories.name: Shape & Generic Precision
categories.description: Loose array and mixed types instead of shapes, lists, and class-strings

categories.name: Contract Honesty
categories.description: Strict, correct types relaxed to satisfy the analyzer instead of proving them

categories.name: Root-Cause Over Inline Assertion
categories.description: Values re-asserted at call sites because the producer was never typed

categories.name: Ignore & Baseline Scoping
categories.description: Broad suppressions that hide the next unrelated defect

categories.name: Analyzer Extensions
categories.description: Casts around dynamic helpers the analyzer was never taught about
